scope: Montenegro medical discovery — University of Montenegro Faculty of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: University of Montenegro's 2026/27 programme catalogue identifies Medicine as a six-year, 12-semester integrated programme carrying 360 ECTS and leading to the professional title doctor of medicine.
The 2026/27 catalogue states that Medicine applicants must have completed grammar school, medical school or Medresa, take chemistry and biology entrance examinations, and compete for 40 places.
UCG says clinical exercises take place in hospitals, clinics and health centres that serve as the Faculty's teaching and research bases; the catalogue does not name the bases.

UCG accepts foreign-student applications for Medicine. Its published foreign-student instructions require secondary-school records including biology and chemistry, Montenegrin-language proficiency and recognition of school credentials; it explicitly states that the Faculty does not offer programmes in English.

Montenegro's Ministry of Health has a rulebook governing the issuance, renewal and withdrawal of medical-doctor licences for people educated at a medical faculty who directly perform health activities in Montenegro, including eligible foreign residents.

holdReasons: No current 2026/27 tuition and mandatory-charge schedule for domestic or foreign Medicine students was located.
The current catalogue names clinical settings generically but does not identify current partner institutions, capacity or placement terms.
Accommodation, scholarships/loans, detailed student-support arrangements and a direct programme accreditation record were not verified from current authoritative sources.
nextAction: Obtain UCG's current Medicine fee notice and direct confirmation of named teaching bases, accommodation/funding and recognition evidence before considering a payload.
